main.description: Returns the representative follow record for an actor-to-actor relationship, or null if none is indexed. No authentication is required.

actor.description: DID of the actor who published the follow record.

subject.description: DID named as the follow record's subject.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A DID or query parameter is invalid.

followRecordView.description: Raw indexed follow record with its publisher DID. For duplicates, the earliest createdAt wins, with URI ascending on ties.

actorFollowView.description: Displayed actor with nullable profile and organization sidecars, paired with the representative follow record.

output.description: Representative raw follow record, or null if no relationship is indexed.

follow.description: Representative record for the actor and subject pair, with URI and publisher metadata.
